key_entities: [ -f <path> ] || { echo '… (change predates the gate)' — skipping; exit 0; }
propositions: The predates-gate shell guard appears 24 times across six workflow files with copy-drift risk (bugs anxious-resistant-urson and sapphire-vulnerable-fruitfly); the guard cannot move to a shared repo file because it would be absent on pre-gate trees.
Two gate steps (check_readme_quickstart.py and probe_rebar.py in test.yml) lack guards while identical steps in gerrit-verify.yaml are guarded, creating uneven protection.

Every gate step must either carry an -f guard naming the file it needs OR carry a mandatory-reason # predates-gate-ok: marker; guarded steps must exit 0 with the canonical message when run in an empty directory.

Four sites carry step behaviour a bare skip would silently drop (_mutation.yml matrix output, _optionality.yml independent guards, _build-and-test.yml inverted guard form, _build-and-test.yml data file guard) and retain current bodies with markers.

Genuine guard gaps (test.yml golden-path and _optionality.yml degradation-path) are filed and linked discovered_from rather than added in this story, because adding a guard changes which gates run on old bases.
